item.title: Fitbit users have over 3 months to switch to a Google account
item.description: After Google bought Fitbit in 2021, it announced a mandatory changeover. item.title: Apple TV is adapting Brandon Sanderson’s The Cosmere universe
item.description: The success of sci-fi series such as For All Mankind, Severance, Foundation, Silo and Pluribus has clearly encouraged Apple TV to go big. The service has acquired the rights to the Cosmere universe, created by the acclaimed fantasy writer Brandon Sanderson. The platform intends to adapt the Mistborn novels into features and to create a TV show based on The Stormlight Archive series. item.title: The truth is, Android 17 won’t matter to most people
item.description: Android is almost two decades old, but it still suffers from the same big problem. While the latest version, Android 16, is available on all supported Google Pixel phones and many of the other best phones around, its rollout to older handsets continues at a glacial pace. The latest distribution figures are an all-too-familiar reminder of this. According to a 9to5Google report, Android 16 is currently installed on a measly 7.5 percent of all Android devices.
